arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Fischl from Genshin Impact, cute and petite, using the two supplied references in distinct roles.
Image 1, the user-supplied in-game model screenshot, is the authoritative source for her character design, face, body proportions, exact costume and accessories. Preserve her blond twin tails, black ribbons, fair skin, visible green right eye with its normal pupil, and black eyepatch over her left eye. Preserve Image 1's exact outfit construction and asymmetry: purple neck bow and gold ornament, black-and-purple gothic bodice with its lace patterns, different sleeves and gloves on the two arms, purple skirt and trailing panels, gold ornaments, asymmetric stockings and their decorative details, and boots. Let the costume tails fall naturally as on the model.
Image 2, the official illustrated portrait, is for ART STYLE ONLY: polished Genshin-inspired anime illustration, clean drawn contours, detailed cel shading with soft painted transitions, and the rendering of hair, cloth and metallic ornaments. Do not copy its elongated silhouette, dramatic arms-overhead pose, windblown hair or costume construction where it differs from the model. Image 1 governs identity and costume details.
Proportions: give Fischl a noticeably smaller, more petite Medium Female anime build. Use a small delicate frame with narrower shoulders, a compact short torso, and proportionately shorter arms and legs, with a slightly larger head relative to the body for a cute balanced anime silhouette. Keep her face soft and gently rounded and her hands small and graceful. Her body should read as compact and petite, not tall or long-legged. Achieve this through actual illustrated proportions, not by shrinking her within a large blank canvas. Keep her recognizable face, character design and exact model outfit; standard anime illustration rather than a chibi mascot.
Neutral acting: a different theatrical Prinzessin idle, like a proud declaration of an extravagant royal title. Turn the torso slightly three-quarter, lift her chin gently, and give her a cute self-assured closed-mouth smile with the visible green eye open and directed toward the viewer. Tilt her head slightly toward her right shoulder for a playful touch of grandeur. Her right hand rests gracefully flat over her upper chest just below the neck bow, fingers naturally together, elbow angled outward in a small courtly flourish. Her left gloved hand rests on her left hip, with a believable relaxed palm and fingers following the waist. Neither hand is near her face or temple, and neither palm is extended outward in a presenting gesture. Keep both hands near the torso and the image plane, with coherent wrists and one thumb and four fingers where visible, without elaborate finger splaying. Settle her weight onto her left leg, with the right foot a little forward and turned slightly outward, knees relaxed and feet clearly separate and uncrossed. Exactly two legs and two feet. Keep her shoulders comfortably open and her back natural rather than arched. Let the hair and costume panels fall with gravity. The grand bearing, hand over heart and proud little smile should communicate her dramatic personality while retaining the cute compact petite build specified above.
Show the complete silhouette including hair ribbons, twin tails, fingers, costume tails and boots with 2–4% top and bottom padding, about 92–96% visible height. Genuinely transparent background. Remove the screenshot's blue scene, particles, floor and reflection. No scenery, UI, text, labels, watermark, floating effects, ground shadow, added props, bow, raven or additional characters.
